title: National Student Clearinghouse: US computer science enrollment fell 12%+ for undergrads and 10%+ for grad students this fall, as AI reduces coding jobs (Elizabeth Rembert/Bloomberg)
summary: Elizabeth Rembert / Bloomberg: National Student Clearinghouse: US computer science enrollment fell 12%+ for undergrads and 10%+ for grad students this fall, as AI reduces coding jobs — Computer and information science departments at US colleges saw an exodus of students this fall, with enrollment declining more than 12% …
